title: Uncollected waste near university hostel block
description: Campus facilities have flagged a persistent pile-up of mixed municipal waste behind Hostel Block C. Municipal collection routes skip this internal road, so garbage accumulates for days, attracting pests and creating a health hazard for ~1,200 resident students. Facilities has photos, weekly weight logs, and a location map.
location: Hostel Block C, Vishwakarma University, Pune

title: Overflowing bins at Ward 14 vegetable market
description: The daily vegetable market generates high volumes of organic waste that overwhelm the two public bins on site. Vendors report overflow by midday. The municipal ward office wants a segregation-and-composting pilot to cut landfill load and create usable compost for nearby parks.

title: Turbid borewell water in rural school cluster
description: Three village schools share borewells that turn visibly turbid after monsoon, forcing classes to buy expensive bottled water. The NGO has collected turbidity readings and household survey data and wants a low-cost filtration pilot validated by researchers.

title: Frequent power outages in campus research labs
description: Research labs experience daily voltage fluctuations and short outages that damage sensitive equipment and interrupt long-running experiments. The energy provider proposes a solar-plus-storage micro-pilot but needs cross-functional validation before scaling.
